title: Full island map, round 4
question: Does this larger island make the station, office and dorm walks clear?

options.label: island-04
options.note: The island03 centre remains, with a distinct station/security building, an open forecourt to head office, a direct fountain-side walk toward the dorms, a larger event field and park, and separate ferry/supply docks beside the old works. The map still has bright, saturated colours and a tidy resort-like finish; that feedback is not resolved. No clear cars or car parks were found on inspection. Exact dorm doors and small shared-building functions such as laundry, sento and pool changing rooms cannot all be verified at this overview scale. No new outdoor game location is built.

decision: Picked (in chat): 'the layout is great! Go with this. Start building it with this layout, but yes less saturated, uses our existing style. Focus on the area we need, not the whole island at once. Break the outdoor locations into chunks you navigate between'
